_comment: SecondSense target models for Qualcomm AI Hub conversion. Module names VERIFIED against qai-hub-models 0.61.0. 'group' controls default selection in convert.py. 'quantize' is left null on purpose: get a working float binary first, quantize as a second pass (Bible §23.2 INT8/W4A8 are intent; the real flag is per-model, so check `python -m qai_hub_models.models.<module>.export --help`).

models.role: HELLO-WORLD — prove the toolchain end-to-end before any real model
models.note: Smallest model. If this compiles+profiles+downloads, the plumbing works.

SWAPPED from yolov11_det: yolo26s tests far more confident on real photos (bottle 0.34-0.57 vs 0.07-0.34) at 5.3ms NPU. Same boxes/scores/class_idx output contract, so YoloDecoder + the bundled asset filename (yolov11_det.tflite) are unchanged. Export needs --ckpt-name yolo26s.pt (default is yolo26n).

models.role: Monocular relative-depth, incl. drop-off case (Bible Depth-Anything-V2)
models.note: Bible wants W4A8 later; confirm real --precision via export --help.

models.role: On-device speech for voice commands (Bible Whisper-Tiny)
models.note: NAME CORRECTED: zoo module is whisper_tiny, NOT whisper_tiny_en. Multi-component (encoder/decoder) — expect multiple assets + longer export.

models.role: Open-vocabulary object grounding (Bible OWL-ViT) — the moat
models.note: Multi-tower (text+image). Fallback option if it fights back: yolo_world (also in the zoo).

models.role: Async hazard-sound detection (horns/sirens) — Bible medium priority
models.note: Only after the spine is green.

models.role: Pixel-level segmentation for precision — Bible optional
models.note: NAME CORRECTED: zoo ships fastsam_x, NOT fastsam_s.
